name: malformed-range-context-null
description: Side's range and context are both JSON null rather than objects; a null must not decode as absent (mirrors malformed-commit-null/malformed-path-null for the range/context pair; WRIT-252 round 7 review). A null on only one of the two is already caught by the range-iff-context check, so this needs both null to isolate the type rule.
